blocks.text: Rahul ki nazar ek pal ke liye Taniya par thehar gayi. Uski nazron mein sirf aam familiarity nahi thi. Taniya ki nazar usse mili, lekin woh aankhein hata kar apne wedding documents check karne lagi.
Tabhi Guddu ka message aaya.
Guddu: “Madam, aapki approval sleeve counter par reh gayi hai.”
Taniya phone uthakar, bina office clothes change kiye, neeche chali gayi.
Guddu wedding decoration ke samples pack kar raha tha. Taniya ko aate dekh usne counter par rakhi approval sleeve uthayi.
Guddu: “Madam, shaadi aapki hai, lekin paperwork sambhalne ki responsibility meri lag rahi hai.”
Taniya: “Zyada khush mat ho. Abhi tumhara quotation approve nahi hua hai.”
Guddu hans diya.
Counter ke side mein ek wedding backdrop laga hua tha, jiska upper sample panel abhi remove karna baaki tha. Taniya documents check karte hue uske paas pahunchi.
Taniya: “Achha, ye design bhi quotation mein included hai?”
Guddu: “Haan madam, bas iska colour change ho jayega.”
Guddu sample frame ka lower adjustment kar hi raha tha ki upar ka lightweight panel achanak ek taraf jhuk gaya.
Guddu: “Madam, sambhalna!”
Taniya ne instinctively dono haath upar uthakar panel ko girne se rok liya. Guddu ne frame ka support sambhala aur fitting dobara secure kar di.

Sudden movement mein Taniya ki sky-blue shirt ka tuck loose ho gaya tha, lekin uska poora dhyaan panel par tha. Guddu ki nazar ek lamhe ke liye shirt ke displaced hem par gayi; usne turant nazar hata kar fitting ki taraf dekhna shuru kar diya. Taniya ko uski exact sightline pata nahi chali.

blocks.alt: Taniya helps steady the wedding panel as Guddu briefly glances toward her unexpectedly displaced shirt.
blocks.caption: Scene 02 · The split-second sightline — Taniya cannot know exactly what Guddu noticed.

blocks.text: Taniya: “Ho gaya? Haath neeche kar sakti hoon ab?”
Guddu: “Ji madam, ho gaya. Sorry.”
Taniya: “Wedding decoration hai ya adventure activity?”
Guddu muskura diya, lekin is baar uske paas koi teasing reply nahi tha. Woh supplies ki taraf jaldi se laut gaya.
Taniya ne approval sleeve uthayi aur lift ki taraf chali gayi.
Inside the Lift — Curiosity Begins
Lift ke mirror mein khud ko dekhte hi Taniya ki nazar apni shirt par padi. Usne loose hem theek kiya.
Tab use Guddu ki achanak khamoshi yaad aayi.
Ek minute… us waqt Guddu ki nazar kahan thi?
Usne kuch notice kiya tha, ya woh sirf frame girne se ghabra gaya tha? Agar notice kiya bhi tha, toh kitna?
Lift ka door khula. Taniya documents lekar bahar nikal gayi, lekin sawaal unanswered raha.

blocks.text: Scene 03 · Complete
Bridge · Morning tension and Guddu's second visit
Taniya flat mein wapas aayi.
Dining table par Soniya aur Rahul saamne baithe the. Dono ki baatcheet uske andar aate hi ruk gayi.
Soniya ne Taniya ko dekha.
Taniya: “Didi, main room mein jaa rahi hoon.”
Soniya ne sir hilaya.
Soniya: “Haan. Hum baat kar rahe hain.”
Taniya ne approval sleeve table par rakhi aur apne bedroom ki taraf chali gayi.
Tabhi doorbell baji.
Soniya ne darwaze ki taraf dekha.
Soniya: “Ek minute, Rahul. Dekhkar aati hoon.”
Woh darwaze ki taraf badhi.
Soniya ne main door khola.
Guddu saamne tha.
Guddu: “Didi, Taniya madam ka pen aur vendor docket neeche reh gaya tha.”
Soniya: “Tum phir aa gaye? Taniya abhi-abhi upar aayi hai.”
Guddu: “Haan didi. Counter band karte waqt mila.”
Soniya: “Waise tumhare backdrop ki kahani bhi sun li maine.”
Guddu ki smile thodi atak gayi.
Guddu: “Arre didi, woh fitting loose thi.”
Soniya: “Maine fitting ke baare mein poochha bhi nahi. Itni safai kyun?”
Guddu ne uski taraf dekha, phir nazar hata li.
Soniya ne notice kar liya.

blocks.text:
Soniya ne doorway mein ek kadam aage badhaya aur haath door frame pe rakh diya. Uska wet dark hair shoulders pe bikhra hua tha, maroon lace crop top uske upper body pe tightly fitted tha — thin straps, deep neckline, aur neeche se midriff clearly open. Matching maroon drawstring bottoms uski waist pe snug the. Gold jhumkas aur necklace uske collarbone pe chamak rahe the. Usne Guddu ki taraf thoda tilt karke dekha, ek slow, knowing smile ke saath.

Guddu ki nazar uske face se neeche gayi — lace ke through soft outline, wet skin pe light sheen, open midriff. Uska expression turant change ho gaya. Smile atak gayi, ears thode laal hue, aur woh ek step peeche hata. Haath mein pen abhi bhi tha lekin grip loose ho gayi.

Soniya ne nazar nahi hatayi.

**Soniya:** “Itni jaldi nazar kyun hat gayi, Guddu babu? Pehle toh fitting ki baat kar rahe the.”

Guddu ne throat clear kiya, aankhein door frame pe rakh kar bola,

**Guddu:** “Didi… main… counter band karne aaya tha. Bas.”

Usne jaldi se pen uske haath mein diya aur peeche mud gaya. Soniya ne dekha uske shoulders tight the, aur woh bina dobara nazar uthaye lift ki taraf badh gaya. Doorway pe sirf uski maroon lace wali silhouette aur Guddu ki retreating back reh gayi.

blocks.text: Parallel B · Rahul and Taniya

Main door par Soniya aur Guddu ki baatcheet chal rahi thi.

Andar Rahul ne apna phone uthaya. Battery low thi. Usne dining table par charger dhoondha, lekin wahan nahi mila.

Use yaad aaya ki shayad charger Taniya ke bedroom mein reh gaya tha.

Woh bedroom corridor ki taraf badha.

Udhar Taniya apne room mein aa chuki thi. Usne laptop bag chair par rakha, approval documents dressing table par chhode aur cupboard se nightwear nikaalne lagi.

Rahul uske darwaze ke paas aakar ruka.

**Rahul:** “Taniya? Mera charger tumhare room mein reh gaya kya?”

Andar se koi clear jawab nahi aaya.

Rahul ne ek baar phir awaaz di.

**Rahul:** “Taniya?”

Phir usne door handle ghumaya.

**Click.**

Darwaza khul gaya.

Door fully open hote hi Rahul ek second ke liye freeze ho gaya.

Taniya cupboard ke saamne khadi thi, peeth thodi uski taraf. Usne sky-blue shirt ke bottom buttons open kiye hue the, shirt ka neeche wala hissa loose ho chuka tha aur charcoal trousers abhi pehne hue the. Uske haath mein nightwear ka set tha, aur woh abhi shirt nikaalne wali thi. Long dark hair ek shoulder pe the, neck aur collarbone pe light sheen.

Rahul ki nazar uske open shirt hem aur exposed midriff pe ek pal ruki. Taniya ne turant palat kar dekha, aankhein badi ho gayin. Shirt ka loose fabric uske against move hua.

**Taniya:** “Rahul…!”
**Rahul:** “Sorry—sorry. Door open tha. Main sirf charger…”

Usne nazar jaldi hata li, haath utha kar back step liya aur door pull karke peeche nikal gaya. Koi contact nahi hua. Door band hote hi andar se Taniya ki tez saans sunai di. Rahul corridor mein khada raha, usne apna phone dekhkar charger dhoondhne ka intention clearly chhod diya aur wapas living area ki taraf mud gaya.
Soniya ne main door band kiya; Rahul living area mein laut aaya, aur Taniya apne kamre mein reh gayi.

blocks.text: LATER THAT NIGHT
Raat ka sannata tha. Taniya apne room mein thi. Ghar mein Soniya aur Rahul nahi the; wedding arrangements ki responsibility lekar dono bahar gaye hue the.

Uske dimaag mein wohi pal ghoom raha tha — shaam wala darwaza. Rahul ne charger ke liye awaaz di thi, phir handle ghuma diya tha. Click. Woh cupboard ke saamne thi, sky-blue shirt ke bottom buttons open, charcoal trousers pehne hue. Usne turant palat kar dekha tha. Rahul ek second freeze hua tha, nazar uske open shirt hem aur midriff pe ruki thi, phir turant “sorry” bolke peeche nikal gaya tha. Koi contact nahi hua tha.

Ab phir se door handle hila.
 Click.
 Taniya ne palat kar dekha.
 Rahul dehleez par khada tha — bilkul usi tarah, soft cotton shirt mein, shoulder lightly against the frame.
Taniya: “Jiju? Aap? Di kahaan hain?”

blocks.alt: Episode 04A Taniya and Rahul — original Google Doc illustration 4

blocks.text: Uske andar ek second ke liye sab ruk gaya. Pichhli baar bhi yahi darwaza khula tha. Us din woh cupboard ke saamne thi aur Rahul ne turant nazar hata li thi. Aaj woh khud pehle hi dekh chuki thi. Uske haath abhi bhi nightwear ke set pe the. Usne unhe side pe rakh diye. Collar ke paas halki si tightness feel hui.

Rahul ne kuch nahi kaha. Usne bas ek chhota sa nod diya, jaise confirm kar raha ho ki woh wahi hai. Uske lips thode parted the, lekin awaaz nahi aayi. Uske andar ek ajeeb sa pull hua — curiosity aur thodi si daring. Woh nahi chahti thi ki yeh baar bhi sirf ek short “sorry” pe khatam ho jaaye.
Usne saans li, dheere se.
Taniya: “Jiju, ek minute.”

Usne door fully open nahi kiya, bas itna ki woh khud doorway ke frame pe haath rakh sake. Rahul abhi bhi threshold pe tha. Uske soft cotton shirt ke collar se halki si heat aa rahi thi. Taniya ne apni nightwear ke set ko side pe phenk diya aur ek kadam aage badhi.
**Taniya:** “Pichhli baar aapne door kholte hi nazar hata li thi. Aaj bhi wahi karenge?”
Rahul ki awaaz thodi low thi.
**Rahul:** “Taniya… main sirf charger ke liye—”
**Taniya:** “Charger toh nahi dikh raha. Kuch aur dekh rahe ho?”

blocks.text: Usne apni shirt ke remaining buttons dheere se khole. Fabric loose hua, collarbone aur upper chest open ho gaye. Room ki dim light uski skin pe pad rahi thi. Rahul ne nazar nahi hatayi is baar. Uske throat pe movement dikhi.
Taniya ne shirt shoulders se sarkayi. Woh bra + panty mein aa gayi — simple cotton, straps thin, waistband low. Usne ek haath door frame pe rakha, doosra apne stomach pe, aur uski taraf dekha.
**Taniya:** “Ab bhi sorry bolne ka mood hai? Ya aaj audit complete karenge?”
Rahul ne ek kadam aage badhaya. Uske trousers mein clear pressure dikh raha tha. Taniya ki nazar wahan gayi, phir uske face pe. Usne halki si smile di.
**Taniya:** “Itna interested ho toh pehle permission lo.”
Usne peeche mudkar door ki taraf bhaagna shuru kiya, abhi bhi bra + panty mein.
**Taniya:** “Get out, shameless!”
Rahul uske peeche ek step badha. Taniya ne darwaze ke paas ruk kar peeche dekha. Uske trousers ke against clear twitch dikha — ek sharp, involuntary movement. Uske lips parted the, saans tez thi.

blocks.text: Taniya ne apne peeche haath le jaakar bra ka hook khola. Straps loose hue. Bra aage se open hua aur girne wala tha, fabric uske chest pe atka hua, neeche sarak raha tha. Usne Rahul ki taraf dekha — uski aankhein uske open bra pe thi, body tight.
Tabhi—
Taniya ki aankhein khul gayin.
